name: Hither Lands
_comment: The locked theme palette. build.py snaps every tile to these colors. Edit here (and keep the /tileset skill's art-direction.md table in sync) to re-theme the whole set; re-run build.py to apply. Warm earthy First-Age mood: warm dark ground, ochre/tan earth and stone, muted forest green, with sparse amber/terracotta/gold jewel accents.
